latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Analyze Video — Extract Insights From Video Content" (version 1.0.0)
- Upload and analyze video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) with automatic AI-driven summarization and key moment identification
- Automatic backend connection and session setup with support for anonymous or API token authentication
- Supports video uploads, exports, credit checks, and session state queries
- Clear error handling and user guidance for file types, size limits, rate limits, and credits
- Designed for marketers, researchers, content creators, and anyone needing quick video insights
